sentences.en: I just want to summarize what is in this deal that Skadden reached with President Trump.

sentences.en: It promises to provide $100 million in pro bono legal services from Skadden to causes that both President Trump and the law firm both support.

sentences.en: Broadly, this is the deal that every major law firm that has come to an agreement has reached with the President.

sentences.en: So what is your reaction to this deal when you finally digest it?

sentences.en: And that's such a new experience because of how prestigious the law firm is.

sentences.en: And then suddenly, in the blink of an eye, in just a few days, hours even, my whole view of the firm has been completely tainted.

sentences.en: This is giving the President a PR win after being bullied.
sentences.zh: 这是在遭到霸凌之后，给总统送上了一场公关上的胜利。

sentences.en: So it seems like I'm working at a firm that, you know, isn't as high caliber as it said it was.

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: But more importantly than that, so many lawyers agree that what the President is doing is wrong,
sentences.zh: 但比这更重要的是，许多律师都认同总统的做法是错误的，

sentences.en: trying to punish his enemies and then coerce any law firm who he perceives as an enemy to either himself or to his circle from being able to represent clients who might be against them.
sentences.zh: 他试图惩罚自己的敌人，然后胁迫任何被他视为自己或其圈子敌人的律所，使其无法代表可能反对他们的客户。

sentences.en: And this is happening in a much bigger political climate where there's fear spreading.
sentences.zh: 而这正发生在一个恐惧正在蔓延的更大政治气候中。

sentences.en: When a judge makes a decision that goes against the President, there shouldn't be politicians calling for their impeachment.

sentences.en: And to see Skadden be complicit to aid this attack, I was so ashamed to work there.
sentences.zh: 而看到世达同流合污助长这种攻击，我为在那里工作感到无比羞耻。

sentences.en: So what did you do?
sentences.zh: 那你做了什么？

sentences.en: So on Sunday night, I start actually just writing down notes and really my questions.
sentences.zh: 所以在周日晚上，我开始动笔写下笔记，其实就是我的问题。

sentences.en: Some of them are practical, like, how is this going to be enforced?
sentences.zh: 其中一些是务实的，比如，这到底将如何执行？

sentences.en: What will it actually look like?
sentences.zh: 实际情况会是什么样？

sentences.en: You're kind of writing to your bosses.
sentences.zh: 你有点像是在写信给你的老板。

sentences.en: Right, what do these, you know, words mean?
sentences.zh: 对，你知道的，这些词到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: And a lot of the questions, I started thinking about it and finding answers, and so the questions became statements.
sentences.zh: 很多问题，我开始思考并找到了答案，于是问题就变成了陈述。

sentences.en: And then I realized what I had written was a draft of a resignation letter.
sentences.zh: 然后我意识到我写的东西是一封辞职信的草稿。

sentences.en: Not necessarily what you set out to do.
sentences.zh: 这不一定是你的初衷。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And Monday comes around, and I have some conversations, you know, in the office with other attorneys.
sentences.zh: 周一到了，我在办公室里与其他律师进行了一些对话。

sentences.en: And my friends and, you know, trusted mentors and colleagues.
sentences.zh: 还有我的朋友，以及，你知道的，值得信赖的导师和同事。

sentences.en: I just wanted to, you know, hear what people had to say and think, and everyone's distraught.
sentences.zh: 我只是想，你知道的，听听大家的说法和想法，每个人都心烦意乱。

sentences.en: Can I ask you to read from parts of the letter?
sentences.zh: 我能请你读一下信中的部分内容吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 好的，当然。

sentences.en: Dear colleagues and friends, I'm writing to let you know that I am leaving this firm.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的同事和朋友们，我写信是为了让你们知道我将离开这家律所。

sentences.en: There was a time when my employment here was so unlikely.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，我在这里获得这份工作是那么不可思议。

sentences.en: For much of my early childhood, I was not a good student.
sentences.zh: 在我的早年童年时期的大部分时间里，我并不是一个好学生。

sentences.en: I struggled to focus in class and take anything seriously.
sentences.zh: 我在课堂上很难集中注意力，也无法认真对待任何事情。

sentences.en: But even then, there was one subject I loved.
sentences.zh: 但即便在那时，也有一门我热爱的科目。

sentences.en: History.
sentences.zh: 历史。

sentences.en: I thought it was so wonderful to learn about all that came before me, about the triumphs and tragedies, about the moments of individual bravery and collective complacency.
sentences.zh: 我觉得了解我之前发生的一切、了解那些胜利与悲剧、了解个人勇敢与集体自满的时刻，是如此奇妙。

sentences.en: I would often imagine myself faced with the same dilemmas.
sentences.zh: 我经常想象自己面临同样的困境。

sentences.en: What would I do if I was there?
sentences.zh: 如果我在那里，我会怎么做？

sentences.en: Would I do the right thing?
sentences.zh: 我会做出正确的选择吗？

sentences.en: It always felt like there was no way to know.
sentences.zh: 总觉得根本无法知道答案。

sentences.en: I believe, as I know many of you do, that what the current presidential administration is doing is wrong.
sentences.zh: 我相信，正如我知道你们许多人也这样认为的那样，现任总统政府正在做的事情是错误的。

sentences.en: That we are sliding into an autocracy where those in power are above the rule of law.
sentences.zh: 我们正在滑向一个专制政体，掌权者凌驾于法律之上。

sentences.en: Well, Skadden's agreement with the Trump administration sent our country deeper down this dissent.
sentences.zh: 然而，世达律师事务所与特朗普政府达成的协议，将我们的国家进一步推向了这种分歧的深渊。

sentences.en: And then I finish,
sentences.zh: 然后我说完了，

sentences.en: Skadden is on the wrong side of history.
sentences.zh: 世达站在了历史错误的一边。

sentences.en: I can no longer stay knowing that someday I would have to explain why I stayed.
sentences.zh: 我再也无法留下来，因为我知道总有一天我必须解释我为什么要留下来。

sentences.en: What did it feel like to hit send?
sentences.zh: 点击发送的那一刻是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I mean, listen to your breathing right now.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听听你现在的呼吸声。

sentences.en: It's like you're reliving it.
sentences.zh: 就像你在重新经历它一样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What was it like to send that email?
sentences.zh: 发送那封电子邮件是什么感觉？

sentences.en: If you heard my breath, it felt like that.
sentences.zh: 如果你听到我的呼吸，那就是那种感觉。

sentences.en: Maybe a hundred times more, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，也许要强烈上百倍吧。

sentences.en: Because I knew that, you know, that was a pivotal moment in my life.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道，你知道的，那是人生中的一个转折点。

sentences.en: Maybe just as pivotal as coming to the United States in the first place.
sentences.zh: 也许和最初来到美国时一样重要。

sentences.en: If I might add, I grew up with two sisters, a twin sister and a younger sister.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，我和两个姐妹一起长大，一个是双胞胎姐姐，还有一个是妹妹。

sentences.en: And my parents asked us, back in Japan, whether we wanted to move to the United States so that we can learn English.
sentences.zh: 在日本时，我们的父母问我们是否想搬到美国，这样我们就可以学习英语。

sentences.en: Actually, that was the reason why.
sentences.zh: 事实上，原因就是这个。

sentences.en: And I remember just thinking, like, I was scared.
sentences.zh: 我只记得当时的想法是，我很害怕。

sentences.en: I don't speak English.
sentences.zh: 我不会说英语。

sentences.en: But I was the one from my sisters who said, like, I think we should.
sentences.zh: 但在姐妹当中，我是那个说“我觉得我们应该去”的人。

sentences.en: And my parents let us choose, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我父母让我们自己选择。

sentences.en: And it felt like that, too.
sentences.zh: 当时的感觉也是这样。

sentences.en: I knew that I was closing some doors and, you know, a place like Skadden, like, for that 10-year-old kid, he had no idea where he might end up.
sentences.zh: 我知道我正在关上一些门，你知道的，像世达这样的一家律所，对于那个十岁的孩子来说，他根本不知道自己最终会落脚何处。

sentences.en: And I'm grateful for that experience.
sentences.zh: 我很感激那段经历。

sentences.en: I think it's only possible in a country like the United States.
sentences.zh: 我认为这只有在像美国这样的国家才有可能实现。

sentences.en: And I really, really believe in it.
sentences.zh: 我是真的、真的很坚信这一点。

sentences.en: I know not everyone can make this decision, including even those in my law firm.
sentences.zh: 我知道并不是每个人都能做出这个决定，甚至包括我所在律师事务所的人。

sentences.en: You know, there are people who have families who depend on their income, who can't just quit on a dime like I did, you know, without a job lined up.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有些人有要靠他们收入养活的家庭，他们不能像我一样说辞职就辞职，你知道的，在没有找好工作的情况下。

sentences.en: There are people who are here at the law firm on work visas because they're not United States citizens.
sentences.zh: 这里有些人凭借工作签证留在律所，因为他们不是美国公民。

sentences.en: And, like, those people can't really speak out because of this climate of intimidation.
sentences.zh: 而且，由于这种恐吓的氛围，这些人真的无法畅所欲言。

sentences.en: Everyone has their own reasons, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想每个人都有自己的理由。

sentences.en: And I just want to say thank you to all the people who read my resignation letter.
sentences.zh: 我只想对所有阅读我辞职信的人说声谢谢。

sentences.en: There have been— I mean, you didn't, we should say, mean for this letter to become—
sentences.zh: 曾经有——我的意思是，你并不是，我们应该说，并没有打算让这封信变得——

sentences.en: As public as it did.
sentences.zh: 像后来那样广为人知。

sentences.en: It kind of just happened.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样发生了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, and I knew that in putting in writing, there was a risk.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且我知道把它写成文字是有风险的。

sentences.en: But, you know, I sent it to my immediate colleagues, and then it was posted online the following day.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，我把它发给了我直接的同事，然后在第二天它就被发到了网上。

sentences.en: I'm sure you're aware that many people who have spoken out against President Trump and his policies have experienced, at times, ferocious blowback.
sentences.zh: 我确信你知道，许多公开反对特朗普总统及其政策的人有时会经历猛烈的回击。

sentences.en: It can be a life-altering event.
sentences.zh: 这可能是改变人生的一件大事。

sentences.en: Is that something you're worried about now?
sentences.zh: 这是你现在担心的事情吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, and I was finally able to talk to my mother after, you know, resigning, telling her that I quit because I hadn't talked to her about my thoughts, you know,
sentences.zh: 是的，你知道的，辞职后我终于能和母亲通话了，告诉她我辞职了，因为我没有和她讨论过我的想法，你知道的，

sentences.en: since it all happened so faSt.
sentences.zh: 因为这一切发生得太快了。

sentences.en: And she's back in Japan, you know, with the rest of my family.
sentences.zh: 而且她还在日本，你知道的，和我的其他家人在一起。

sentences.en: And I told her I quit, and she was like, do you have another job?
sentences.zh: 我告诉她我辞职了，她就问：你找到另一份工作了吗？

sentences.en: And I was like, no, Mom, you don't understand.
sentences.zh: 我说：没有，妈，你不明白。

sentences.en: Like, this is, like, in the news.
sentences.zh: 这，这就好比，上新闻了。

sentences.en: And I quit because of what's going on in America right now.
sentences.zh: 我辞职是因为美国现在发生的事情。

sentences.en: That's the question my mother would ask me.
sentences.zh: 这就是我母亲会问的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, and she sort of didn't process it at first, and then she started to cry.
sentences.zh: 是的，她一开始有点没反应过来，然后就哭了起来。

sentences.en: She realized what's happening, and she asked me to come back to Japan.
sentences.zh: 她意识到了发生了什么，并要求我回日本。

sentences.en: I said, no, like, I can't, and I won't.
sentences.zh: 我说：不，我不能，我也不会。

sentences.en: I made this decision because I believe that there's still hope, and I owe it to America, I think, to stay here and speak out on this issue.
sentences.zh: 我做出这个决定是因为我相信希望依然存在，而且我认为我亏欠美国，应该留在这里，就这个问题大声疾呼。

sentences.en: Many of your colleagues are not leaving their jobs.
sentences.zh: 你的许多同事并没有离开他们的工作。

sentences.en: And there's a spectrum of reasons that you've started to hint at about why they're not leaving.
sentences.zh: 关于他们为什么不离开，你已经开始暗示了一系列的原因。

sentences.en: They may feel the way you feel and have two kids they have to put through college.
sentences.zh: 他们可能和你有一样的感受，却有两个孩子要供上大学。

sentences.en: They might not feel the way you feel.
sentences.zh: 他们可能没有和你有一样的感受。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about reporting my colleagues did inside the upper echelons of Paul Weiss when that law firm did a deal with Trump.
sentences.zh: 我想到了我的同事在保尔·维斯律所高层内部所做的报道，当时那家律所与特朗普达成了一笔交易。

sentences.en: And it became clear that the majority of the people who run the firm, and lots of them, felt that the best thing to do was to make a deal.
sentences.zh: 并且很明显，管理律所的大多数人，以及其中许多人，都觉得最好的做法是达成交易。

sentences.en: And the reason that they articulated they felt that way is that, in their minds, they had to protect the thousands of people who work at these firMs.
sentences.zh: 他们阐明自己之所以有这种感觉，是因为在他们看来，他们必须保护在这些律所工作的数千人。

sentences.en: They may have hated the deal.
sentences.zh: 他们可能讨厌这笔交易。

sentences.en: Some of them no doubt hate the deal.
sentences.zh: 他们当中毫无疑问有人讨厌这笔交易。

sentences.en: But they felt their job was to make sure that these firms survives, lives through this period of time.
sentences.zh: 但他们觉得自己的职责是确保这些律所生存下来，度过这段时期。

sentences.en: And that at the end of the day, what they're giving up is small compared to that survival.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，与这种生存相比，他们放弃的东西微不足道。

sentences.en: And the bosses at all these firms that end up capitulating to Trump say some version of, we are the same law firm after we did these deals as we were before.
sentences.zh: 所有这些最终向特朗普屈服的律所的老板们，都会说类似这样的话：我们在达成这些交易后，和以前是同一家律所。

sentences.en: In fact, in a company-wide email, your former boss says just that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在你前老板发给全公司的一封邮件中，他说的正是这个。

sentences.en: Quote, this agreement does not change who we are.
sentences.zh: 原话是：“这项协议并没有改变我们是谁。”

sentences.en: What do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: I just don't think that's true.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这不是真的。

sentences.en: These law firms are agreeing to these deals when they know that there's no legal basis for any threat in the executive order.
sentences.zh: 这些律所明知行政令中的任何威胁都没有法律依据，却仍然同意了这些交易。

sentences.en: And to the extent that these firms feel an existential threat to the firm itself, by capitulating, they're aiding this existential threat against the profession,
sentences.zh: 就这些律所感到律所本身面临生存威胁而言，通过屈服，它们正在推波助澜，加剧这种针对整个法律界、

sentences.en: the independence of the judiciary, and our democracy and everyone who depends on it.
sentences.zh: 司法独立、我们的民主以及依赖这一切的每个人的生存威胁。

sentences.en: It does change who the firm is.
sentences.zh: 这确实改变了这家律所的本质。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In short.
sentences.zh: 简而言之。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think all of these firms that are making these deals and defecting, they're worried about losing clients to a peer firm that's connected to the administration already.
sentences.zh: 我认为所有这些达成交易并背叛原则的律所，都在担心失去客户，输给那些已经与政府建立联系的同行律所。

sentences.en: And these firms are betting on the president to succeed, right, from a PR perspective, because they can say, look, it was a smart deal.
sentences.zh: 从公关的角度来看，这些律所把赌注押在总统能够成功上，对吧？因为它们可以说，看，这是一笔明智的交易。

sentences.en: But the smart deal is with this president who is trying to actively undermine our profession and our democracy.
sentences.zh: 但明智的交易却是与这位正试图积极破坏我们行业和民主的总统进行的。

sentences.en: And, you know, for the firm to say, hey, it doesn't change who we are.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，律所说“嘿，这没有改变我们是谁”。

sentences.en: I think it fundamentally does.
sentences.zh: 我认为它从根本上改变了。

sentences.en: You very clearly have a lot of faith in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 很明显，你对美国有着极大的信念。

sentences.en: That's just been evident throughout this entire conversation.
sentences.zh: 在整个对话过程中，这一点显而易见。

sentences.en: And your decision to quit seems to be grounded in the sense of what is the best version of what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你辞职的决定似乎根植于你心中对美国最好状态的理解。

sentences.en: can be in your mind.
sentences.zh: 但在经历这一切之后，你现在有多大把握——

sentences.en: But at this point, how confident are you, given everything you've just been through,
sentences.zh: 确信那个似乎成为你在这里所做一切核心的美国版本，现在就是真正的美国版本？

sentences.en: that the version of the United States that seems to be at the center of everything you've done here is now the version of the United States?
sentences.zh: 之所以有把握，是因为那么多的人——那些陌生人，你知道的，联系我并对我说的话——他们也在害怕。

sentences.en: Confident because of what so many people, strangers, you know, reaching out to me have said to me, which is that they're also scared.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在害怕。

sentences.en: Everyone is scared.
sentences.zh: 但如果每个人都能，你知道的，站出来，大声说出这件事，那么我们就能扭转局面。

sentences.en: But if everyone could, you know, stand up and speak up about this, then we can turn this back.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们仍然能够拯救它。

sentences.en: I think we can save it still.
sentences.zh: 但你难道没有一点担心，觉得自己押错了注，也许律所——不管你对此感到多么痛苦——

sentences.en: But are you a little bit worried that you're making the wrong bet and that maybe the law firms, as much as it might pain you to think about it this way,
sentences.zh: 才是此刻做出了明智押注的一方？

sentences.en: are making the sound bet in this moment?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我当然，你知道的，有所担心，我想。

sentences.en: Well, of course I'm, you know, worried, I guess.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我为此赌上了我的职业生涯，我在做出决定时就知道这一点。

sentences.en: You know, I'm putting my career on the line for this, and I knew that going into this.
sentences.zh: 我有学生贷款。

sentences.en: I have student loans.
sentences.zh: 我有一个单亲妈妈，你知道的。

sentences.en: I have a single mom who, you know.
sentences.zh: 而你刚刚公开跟总统干了一架。

sentences.en: And you just publicly picked a little bit of a fight with the president.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这段经历是否让你对从事法律行业产生了质疑。

sentences.en: I wonder if this experience made you question going into law.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，法律在理论上是一回事。

sentences.en: I mean, law is one thing in theory.
sentences.zh: 而在实践中又是另一回事，特别是在这些大型律所里。

sentences.en: And then it's another thing in practice, especially at these big law firMs.
sentences.zh: 这些可不是非营利组织。

sentences.en: These are not nonprofits.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 这也是我在法学院找工作、寻找第一份工作时做出决定的部分原因。

sentences.en: And that's part of the decision I made when I was in law school finding a job, my first job.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，要回答你的最终问题，不，我没有，我不后悔成为一名律师并读法学院。

sentences.en: And, you know, to answer your ultimate question, no, I don't, I don't regret becoming a lawyer and going to law school.
sentences.zh: 这是一次极好的教育。

sentences.en: It's a wonderful education.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，甚至在世达的这段时间里，我也学到了很多东西。

sentences.en: You know, even my time at Skadden, I learned so much.
sentences.zh: 我认为它赋予了我技能，让我能够为自己的信仰以及为他人发声。

sentences.en: And it's equipping me with skills, I think, to advocate for what I believe in and for others as well.
sentences.zh: 这就是律师所做的事。

sentences.en: And that's what lawyers do.
sentences.zh: 好的，托马斯，谢谢你来到这里并给我们讲这个故事。

sentences.en: Well, Thomas, thank you for coming in here and for telling us this story.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很感激。

sentences.en: We really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 周五，数百家律所对珀金斯·科伊律所表达了支持，该律所是第一家遭到特朗普总统攻击的律所，

sentences.en: On Friday, hundreds of firms threw their support behind the first firm to be attacked by President Trump, Perkins Coie,
sentences.zh: 它已起诉政府，以阻止特朗普针对该律所的行政令。

sentences.en: which has sued the administration to stop Trump's executive order against the firm.
